acceptance_criteria.statement: Objective progress, lifecycle-only PR denial, reconciliation routing, and administration budgets have executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.
Repository traceability, upstream-adoption truth, assurance migrations, evidence, and later-pass truth boundaries remain consistent.

definition_of_done: Implementation is present and locally behaviorally verified.
Worker or upstream-tool claims cannot directly establish final project completion.
Pass 16 verification-harness work remains accurately dispositioned rather than hidden.
description: Implement the original-pack Progress Delta and hygiene-budget ideas as fail-closed delivery controls. The cohesive slice calculates objective progress, stops progressless administrative cycling, routes already-implemented work to batch reconciliation, rejects lifecycle-only micro-PRs in CI, and preserves the final-project truth boundary.
exclusions: No Pass 16 golden-journey/browser/accessibility/performance/fault/mutation harness is claimed complete.
No final project completion is claimed by this task.
objective: Enforce objective delivery progress and prevent lifecycle micro-PR loops
observability_impact: Criterion, truth, evidence, loop, scope, review, candidate-completion, and final gate decisions are structured and queryable.
rationale: Completion must be evidence-backed, bounded, independently reviewable, resistant to loops/scope drift, and unable to self-certify unfinished later-pass work.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve append-only evidence and immutable assurance history; roll back code/schema without rewriting prior truth or gate decisions.
security_impact: Assurance authority is fail-closed around stale/unknown evidence, scope expansion, self-review, repeated attempts, and unsupported completion claims.
title: Enforce objective delivery progress and lifecycle batching
